snippet.title: De La Jet Set Radio [Dreamcast Japanese gameplay]
snippet.description:
De La Jet Set Radio/Deluxe Jet Set Radio (known as デ・ラ・ジェット セット ラジオ / De Ra Jetto Setto Rajio in Japan)‎ is a Japanese-only re-release of Jet Set/Grind Radio that included several bugfixes, a complete Europe/USA soundtrack and two levels that weren't present in the original NTSC-J release. 

Even though it's japanese only, it still contains the multi-lang text data/english cutscene voices.
